title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Battery Upgrade Could Bring 5000mAh Capacity and Longer Battery Life
summary: Reports suggest the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 could receive a battery upgrade to around 5000mAh, promising longer battery life for the foldable flagship. If accurate, the larger capacity may improve endurance for heavy users and reflect ongoing efforts to address battery concerns in premium foldables.
